notes.title: Quality of Life - Update 2
notes.notes:
Hello you busy package bees!

We have a few renewals, additions and improvements for you.

Big packages are smaller.
Some players had the problem with very large packages that they could no longer reach the tools underneath the package or accidentally had a tool in their hand while turning. This should be fixed by "smaller" large packages now.

Warning stickers are explained in more detail.
Warning stickers now have their own tab as soon as they become relevant. Here all objects are listed again, which are to be connected with the appropriate sticker. 

New Mode: Relaxed Work (more time)
We have noticed that many players do not get along with the mode "With time pressure", the further you progress in the game. Here we decided to make a more relaxed, but still with time limit, mode. You have about 60 seconds per package here.

Also, you can reselect the difficulty level on gameover if it was too hard or too easy for you after all.

Rotate packages with tool possible
Often requested and now possible: as soon as you have the tape or the black light in your hand, you can still rotate the package!

Logic error for import and export fixed
Foreign mail is from now on no longer affected by the domestic rule (rule: 3kg food maximum)

Twitchintegration
Your mods can now help you clean your book again. Or you can just drink less Fritz Kola ;D
!cleanup - clean up the book
